finding.sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID after revoking the first session, to test whether assertion replay protection is independent of session state (should still reject second use).

finding.sequence_description: I3 stale-flow acceptance test: start an SP-initiated SAML flow, then remove the SAML source endpoint and attempt to complete authentication. Expect rejection (no acceptance of stale/suspended flow after config removal).

Assertion FAILED: user_after_cleanup_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_after_cleanup_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: authentik accepted completion of a SAML flow after the SAML source endpoint was removed (stale flow acceptance).

sequence.description: I3 stale-flow acceptance test: start an SP-initiated SAML flow, then remove the SAML source endpoint and attempt to complete authentication. Expect rejection (no acceptance of stale/suspended flow after config removal).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: A suspended SP-initiated SAML flow must not remain completable after the underlying SAML source is removed; completion must be rejected to preserve atomicity and configuration coherence.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Test invalid: control SAML login failed; cannot attribute later rejection/acceptance to coherence behavior.

Evaluation: user_takeover_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: authentik accepted completing a victim flow context (RelayState/InResponseTo) with a different principal's assertion.

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: The SP-initiated SAML flow context must be bound to the initiating session and intended principal; completing the same flow with a different principal must be rejected (no cross-principal splicing).
